1. `.unwrap()` on parse -- replaced with `map_err(|_| ParseError::Invalid)`
2. No empty input check -- added `input.is_empty()` → `ParseError::Empty`
3. No `max_items` enforcement -- added length check before each push → `ParseError::TooMany`
4. `split(',').map(...).collect()` pattern -- replaced with bounded `for` loop + `try_reserve` + `ParseError::Allocation`
